title: Decraftable
description: lets you decraft items for your resources back.
body:
Reverse Crafting lets you decraft certain Minecraft items back into their base materials.
It’s a simple, survival friendly way to reclaim resources from items you no longer need without breaking game balance.

Features
Decraft select items into their original ingredients.

Balanced system: more complex materials only return a portion of the resources used to craft them.

Seamless integration: designed to feel like a natural addition to vanilla Minecraft.

Gameplay
Reverse Crafting focuses on fair resource recovery, not duplication.
It rewards players for thoughtful crafting decisions while discouraging exploits or infinite loops.
More advanced items yield fewer materials to maintain balance and challenge.
